newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Steel to reorganize sheet product efforts.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Steel to reorganize sheet product efforts.

text.p: The U. S. Steel Group of USX Corp said Thursday it plans a major reorganization of its sheet product sales, marketing and production organization.
The restructuring, to be effective Jan. 1, was triggered by the retirement of Reuben L. Perin Jr, longtime executive vice president - commercial for the company, it said.

"This consolidation of U. S. Steel's sheet product operations and commercial activity in an overall business unit is consistent with our earlier restructuring of the plate and tubular product organizations as unified production and sales groups," the steel maker said in a statement.

"The approach has been very effective for us in relation to serving customers in those product lines. We're confident the approach will work equally well with respect to our participation in the sheet product market."

In the realignment of U. S. Steel's sheet product business, Roy G. Dorrance will become executive vice president - sheet products. Dorrance, who has been vice president - operations since 1995, will head production, sales and marketing of the sheet product line.

J. Paul Kadlic was elected vice president - sales for the sheet products unit. Kadlic, who will report to Dorrance, has been general manager of U. S. Steel's automotive group at Detroit responsible for sales and marketing of the product line to the automotive industry.
Kadlic, widely known in automotive circles, has headed U.S. Steel's Detroit and Central Area sales activity since 1982. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.
